description: Implementation of the SurfaceEGL class, which provides EGL surface management and operations for the ANGLE project, including buffer swapping, surface configuration, and extension support.

classes.name: SurfaceEGL
classes.description: A class managing EGL surfaces, providing methods for buffer swapping, surface configuration, and extension support within the ANGLE graphics library.

methods.name: SurfaceEGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SurfaceEGL object with surface state, EGL functions, and configuration.

methods.name: ~SurfaceEGL
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the EGL surface if it exists.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Sets the surface as current; handled in DisplayEGL.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers of the surface.

methods.name: swapWithDamage
methods.description: Swaps buffers with damage regions if supported.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to post a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: setPresentationTime
methods.description: Sets the presentation timestamp for the surface.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to query surface pointer.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases a texture image from the surface.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the surface.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the surface.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Unimplemented; indicates if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns the swap behavior of the surface.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Returns the underlying EGL surface handle.

methods.name: setTimestampsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables frame timestamping if supported.

methods.name: getSupportedCompositorTimings
methods.description: Retrieves supported compositor timings.

methods.name: getCompositorTiming
methods.description: Retrieves specific compositor timing data.

methods.name: getNextFrameId
methods.description: Retrieves the next frame ID.

methods.name: getSupportedTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves supported frame timestamps.

methods.name: getFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves timestamps for a specific frame.
